lanes.name: Full Signal
lanes.narrative: Close the gap between Audial and your Spotify account — ending with your full listening life, including real-time history and full-length playback, woven into your channel.

lanes.name: The Broadcast Moment
lanes.narrative: Give publishing a dramatic arc — from private drafts to a deliberate go-live gesture, with notifications ensuring every broadcast reaches the people tuned in.

lanes.name: Community Transmission
lanes.narrative: Layer a social signal on top of curation — from a single intentional mark to liner-note annotations to full collaborative sets built between curators.

lanes.name: New Frequencies
lanes.narrative: Expand Audial beyond the browser and beyond Spotify — into Apple Music, a native mobile radio that plays through your locked screen, and embeds on any surface on the web.

lanes.name: The Signal Economy
lanes.narrative: Give curators the tools to understand their reach, surface their taste to new audiences weekly, and turn their channel into something worth paying for.
